verdict.rationale: Braintrust's own Patterns feature runs its Loop agent over the trace backlog on a schedule, so the product does ship one recurring job. There is no evidence that users can define, configure, or schedule their own arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, such as scheduled eval runs. Online scoring is triggered as logs arrive rather than on a recurring schedule, and the CI/CD evals run per pull request on the host's pipeline, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring job or workflow scheduling, control over schedule timing (cron or interval), scheduled eval or experiment runs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Patterns puts Loop to work on your trace backlog on a schedule.
